t: A zero-code AI and block programming platform for Seeed boards, sold to schools.
steps: Find the CodeCraft for Education page and contact Seeed about a seat package.
Ask for pricing and the privacy terms.
Ask IT to review the privacy terms. The page says Seeed monitors teaching data in real time.
Generate a course code in the admin panel.
Set the session length and class size.
Have students enter the code in the browser.
Check that the browser supports flashing over USB. Chromebook support is not stated.
